title: Original-review read: put the exact resultId in the parent's compact packet and have exact_identity_required name where to find it
outcome: A non-parent reader can find the exact submissionAttempt and resultId of an original review from the parent's compact packet. When it omits them, the 400 exact_identity_required says where to find them. The exact-identity guard itself is unchanged.
acceptance: The parent's compact delegation packet includes the resultId for each retained submission attempt (guard at src/delegation_review_attempts.rs:957-961, unchanged).

The 400 exact_identity_required message names the cause and where to read the resultId. A behavioral test shows a non-parent read succeeding with the identity taken from the packet, and still refused without it.
The independent review pair has no outstanding Medium-or-higher finding, and the full gate passes on the exact landed input.

completion.summary: Landed in 8577f5ec. The parent’s compact delegation result exposes each confirmed retained review identity, including recuts, and the exact-identity refusal points readers to those IDs. The independent-reader access guard is unchanged.
